description: Self-contained Insightly CRM REST API v3.1 workhorse. HTTP Basic auth (API key as username, blank password) against a pod-specific host (https://api.{pod}.insightly.com/v3.1). Retries on 429 (logs X-RateLimit headers) / 5xx. .get()/.post()/.put() primitives plus .search() (field_name/field_value lookup) and .upsert() (emulated find-then-create-or-update — Insightly has no native upsert).

outputs.description: InsightlyResource with .get/.post/.put/.search/.upsert methods. Consumed by insightly_record_upsert (sink) and by custom Dagster asset code that needs Insightly CRUD.

api_key_env_var.label: Api Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Insightly API key (used as HTTP Basic username, blank password).

pod.label: Pod
pod.description: Insightly pod identifier, from your account's API Settings page (directly under your API key), e.g. 'na1'.

max_retries.label: Max Retries
max_retries.description: Retry attempts on 429 / 5xx (exponential backoff, capped at 10s).

name: Insightly Resource
